shared_platform_plugin.purpose: shared WordPress infrastructure, navigation, platform sync, health, registry and common services

rules: OMOS does not create a competing member database
OMOS does not infer membership level or standing from shortcode availability
Personal WordPress user context is returned only from the authenticated members route
Membership checkout and transaction truth remain in WordPress/WooCommerce and the membership plugin

security_boundary: OMOS_BRIDGE_API_KEY server configuration is preferred over database storage
public REST responses never expose the bridge key or personal member context
WordPress does not own Council authority, Human Gate, Decision Records or PostgreSQL
WordPress does not authorize deployments, payments, credential changes or consequential external actions
authenticated Ask OMOS submits to the governed runtime and does not create a competing local Decision Record store
authenticated member context remains WordPress-local and is not treated as OMOS membership authority

verification.repository_gate: PHP syntax + manifest contract + shortcode registry contract + Members integration contract
verification.live_gate: verify installed version, /wp-json/omos/v1/sync, authenticated /wp-json/omos/v1/members, shortcode health and runtime connectivity per target site
verification.production_rule: Repository implementation alone does not certify a live WordPress installation, membership state, or the OMOS runtime.
